intended_audience: Corporate QSR and fast-casual brand teams
concept: Fictional hybrid chicken-focused chain; 40 restaurants, four regions, 24 months planned
grain_policy: Independent weekly store/channel/daypart and store/item grains; never multiply fact rows with a many-to-many join

fields.name: closed_on
fields.definition: Last trading date; blank if still operating

fields.name: timezone
fields.definition: IANA restaurant time zone, e.g. America/Los_Angeles

Restaurant_Master.notes: One region per restaurant during V1 history; reorganizations require a later effective-dated dimension.

fields.name: retired_on
fields.definition: Chain-wide retirement date, blank if active

Menu_Master.notes: Chain-wide dates do not establish availability at each restaurant. Missing item rows are not presumed zero sales.

fields.name: source_id
fields.definition: Unique source key referenced in fact tables

fields.name: source_type
fields.definition: POS export, store status, finance, campaign system etc.

fields.name: sales_basis
fields.definition: What the data measures, e.g. consumer restaurant POS, not corporate wholesale

fields.name: expected_operating_days
fields.definition: Days scheduled to trade that week (1-7)

fields.name: disruption_flag
fields.definition: TRUE if closure/disruption makes week not comparable

Store_Week_Status.notes: Must exist for every reported restaurant-week; separate true zero sales from missing feed. Partial weeks are excluded from comparisons requiring complete periods.

Sales_Weekly.grain: One row per restaurant × week × channel × daypart

fields.name: daypart
fields.definition: Mutually exclusive, based on local order placed time

fields.name: gross_sales_usd
fields.definition: Product/menu gross sales before discounts/refunds, excluding sales tax, tips, and third-party pass-through fees

fields.name: discount_usd
fields.definition: Discount deductions, entered as positive dollars

fields.name: refund_usd
fields.definition: Refund/return deductions, entered as positive dollars

fields.name: net_sales_usd
fields.definition: Gross minus discounts minus refunds, excluding tax, tips and pass-through fees

fields.name: transaction_count
fields.definition: Unique completed non-voided orders attributed once to one channel and one daypart

Sales_Weekly.notes: Source of truth for sales, transactions, average check, channels, dayparts and comparable-location sales. Zero-activity weeks require explicit zero POS record.

Menu_Weekly.grain: One row per restaurant × week × menu item

fields.name: units_sold
fields.definition: Net sold units (V1 nonnegative); all chargeable items and modifiers represented as menu items

fields.name: item_order_count
fields.definition: Distinct completed orders containing this item (optional for attach rate)

fields.name: item_net_sales_usd
fields.definition: Net item revenue after attributed discounts/refunds, excluding tax/tips/pass-through fees

Menu_Weekly.notes: No order/transaction counts added over menu items. Does not contain channel or daypart: cross-filtering menu item sales by them is unsupported. Complete restaurant-weeks must reconcile to POS net sales.

Promotions_Weekly.grain: One row per restaurant × week × promotion

fields.name: redemption_count
fields.definition: Attributed redemptions, not necessarily distinct transactions across overlapping promotions

fields.name: discount_cost_usd
fields.definition: Discount cost subset of POS discounts; not incremental revenue

Promotions_Weekly.notes: Future module only; do not claim lift or add promotion sales into POS totals. Multiple discounts can apply to one order.

fields.name: financial_net_revenue_usd
fields.definition: Financial system net revenue under documented accounting basis

fields.name: labor_cost_usd
fields.definition: Payroll and directly related cost, positive

fields.name: other_operating_cost_usd
fields.definition: Other restaurant operating expenses under documented scope, positive

Financials_Weekly.notes: Future module only. Reconcile POS vs financial revenue before showing ratios. Simplified operating contribution is not audited operating profit or EBITDA.

kpis.net_sales_usd: SUM Sales_Weekly.net_sales_usd over selected fully reported scope
kpis.transactions: SUM Sales_Weekly.transaction_count over selected fully reported scope
kpis.average_check_usd: net_sales_usd / transactions, N/A when transactions = 0; calculate from summed numerators/denominators, never average rows
kpis.discount_rate: SUM discount_usd / SUM gross_sales_usd, N/A when gross=0
kpis.sales_growth_pct: (current net sales / matched prior net sales) - 1; N/A if prior <= 0 or incomplete
kpis.transaction_growth_pct: (current transactions / matched prior transactions) - 1; N/A if prior <= 0 or incomplete
kpis.comparable_store_sales_growth_pct: (SUM current sales across identical eligible locations and aligned weeks / SUM prior sales across same exact set) - 1
kpis.average_unit_volume_usd: SUM restaurant net sales / count of eligible restaurant-year equivalents for selected reporting period; do not label an arbitrary partial-period average as annual AUV
kpis.menu_item_mix_pct: SUM item_net_sales_usd / SUM all menu item revenue in same complete menu scope
kpis.menu_item_attach_rate: SUM item_order_count / SUM Sales_Weekly.transaction_count over identical store-weeks; only when item_order_count complete and menu item rows explicitly cover target stores
kpis.realized_item_price_usd: SUM item_net_sales_usd / SUM units_sold; not menu/list price; N/A when units=0
kpis.store_rank: Sort comparable net sales or growth within an explicitly selected valid cohort; do not rank partial-coverage stores as if comparable
kpis.promotional_discount_rate_optional: SUM Promotions_Weekly.discount_cost_usd / SUM Sales_Weekly.gross_sales_usd, only same scope with complete attribution
kpis.financial_operating_contribution_optiona: financial_net_revenue_usd - food_cogs_usd - labor_cost_usd - other_operating_cost_usd; only if expense categories are complete and scope matched

rules: Week_end must be Sunday and a true date, not an arbitrary string; one calendar throughout input.
All primary keys unique; all foreign keys resolve. Reject future dates after extraction and dates outside operating life.
For Sales_Weekly: gross, discount, refund and transaction count are >=0; net = gross-discount-refund within $0.01; negative net cannot be used for average check without review.
For Menu_Weekly: units >=0; item_order_count if present 0..units, and no greater than same-store-week transactions; item revenue may be nonzero only with positive units (V1).
For every Store_Week_Status=Complete, require matching Sales_Weekly coverage, including explicit zero record when there were no orders; missing records are never silently zero.

For menu_coverage_status=Complete and POS coverage Complete: SUM Menu_Weekly.item_net_sales_usd must equal store-week SUM Sales_Weekly.net_sales_usd within $0.01. Otherwise reject or flag for remediation. Partial/Missing menu status disables whole-store menu-mix and menu-to-sales claims.
Source IDs and sale basis must be documented; refuse to blend restaurant consumer POS with corporate royalties, franchise billings, or vendor shipments.
No many-to-many raw fact joins. Filter and aggregate each fact table to matching store-week grains, then join aggregate results only.
For YoY comparison align each selected current week to 364 days earlier, require complete records for same store-weeks and select one fixed cohort for the whole compared period.

Comparable store eligible only if open >=13 calendar months as of current comparison week, has complete data and expected=actual operating days >0 in both aligned weeks, and no disruption flags; require eligibility for every matched week in the selected window.
53-week fiscal calendars, store region reassignments, split tickets across dayparts, and inferred promo lift are unsupported in V1.
Zero versus missing must remain distinct; never infer zero sold items from absent Menu_Weekly rows.
